findings.title: JWT field mismatch in payments.ts
findings.description: authMiddleware sets req.user.userId, but payments.ts reads user.id. Change payments.ts to read user.userId or extend the middleware to also populate id.

findings.title: JWT field mismatch in auth.ts response
findings.description: Database returns user_type, but tests expect userType. Transform DB column to camelCase in register/login responses.

findings.title: Auth route inconsistency
findings.description: /me, PATCH /me, and change-password are mounted on /api/v1/auth (no authMiddleware), so they manually verify the JWT but then can't run under the test harness without the stub app. Consider moving them to /api/v1/profile or /api/v1/user so they sit behind authMiddleware.

findings.title: Misleading documentation claim
findings.description: README.md still contains 'Planned Future Architecture' section listing Go fleet-tracker, Python AI, Kafka, TimescaleDB, Elasticsearch. The brief says these were removed, but they're present. Either remove the section entirely or acknowledge it as future roadmap.

findings.title: Missing PATCH /me validation test
findings.description: No test for what happens when the DB update fails (e.g., network timeout, constraint violation). Add a test that mocks query to reject.

findings.title: Missing payment transaction conflict test
findings.description: No test for concurrent payment attempts that would trigger a DB serialization failure. Add a test that mocks getClient().query to throw a serialization error and verify the response is 500 or 409.

findings.title: GPS validation not tested
findings.description: validateGpsObservation is called in tracking.ts but no test exercises an invalid GPS coordinate (e.g., lat > 90, speed < 0). Add a test that sends invalid GPS and verifies the response is 400.

findings.title: Missing README.md reference to test command
findings.description: SETUP.md documents npm test thoroughly, but README.md's 'Running Tests' section doesn't mention that tests require no live DB or internet. Add a note that all external dependencies are mocked.

findings.title: Payment client release not verified
findings.description: Payments tests don't verify that db.release() is called. Add .toHaveBeenCalled() assertions on mockClient.release in the happy-path tests to catch pool leaks.
